messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — HelixX sent an RFP last night. They want: capability matrix, POC plan (2-week), pricing tiers for hosted vs dedicated, KMS/HSM support details, and SOC/FedRAMP posture. Can owners pls ack and we’ll assemble answers?

maria_solutions: ack. I can draft the capability matrix and written answers. Need the tech bullets from eng + security notes.

kevin_security: I can cover KMS/HSM and compliance summary. Quick note: HelixX asked about customer-managed KMS in our Private deployment — we support BYOK via KMS but not HSM in hosted by default. For on-prem we can integrate HSMs (PKCS#11). Will add sample KMS policy snippet.

jamie_engineering: Re: POC env — we can spin a Dedicated test pool with 2x A100 equiv for the two-week window. Constraints: no production data; provide a small synthetic dataset or a redacted sample. Also need 48hrs lead time to provision and network peering details.

zach_devex: I have a one-click quickstart and a sample terraform snippet that sets up a VPC peering + egress rules. I’ll paste snippets into the doc. Link to sample: https://internal.redwood/quickstarts/poctemplate (private).

lina_salesops: For pricing, HelixX wants a quote with committed monthly tiers and an overage rate. Proposed template: base dedicated commit (monthly) + per-1M-token incremental. I’ll prepare a spreadsheet. Who can confirm expected token volumes for their use-case?

alex_sales: HelixX said they expect 100M tokens/month in steady state, spiking to 400M during trials. Put both conservative and peak rows in the quote.

kevin_security: Add: audit logs retention policy options (30/90/365 days) and SIEM integrations (syslog/S3). We need to note export controls and minimum role-based access controls. Also call out that encryption-in-transit uses TLS1.3 and at-rest uses AES-256 with KMS-wrapped keys.

maria_solutions: Timeline proposal: Day 0: contract + NDAs. Day 1-2: infra provisioning. Day 3-5: warm models + smoke tests. Day 6-12: customer-run evals + sample production traffic. Day 13-14: acceptance testing and handoff. Acceptance criteria: latency under 200ms p95 for 512-token requests, 99.5% successful responses, and embedding similarity regression within 2% vs baseline.

jamie_engineering: For model selection, we recommend Redwood-verified 13B quantized variant for cost/latency balance, with fallback to larger model if quality fails. We'll include a perf/cost matrix (tokens/sec, $/1M tokens).

zach_devex: Shipping docs: I’ll drop a quickstart, sample eval scripts, and a config snippet with batching settings. Example config: ```{
  "batch_size": 32,
  "max_latency_ms": 150,
  "kv_cache": "enabled"
}```

alex_sales: Action items: Maria to produce capability matrix draft by EOD tomorrow; Kevin to drop KMS/HSM + compliance blurb; Jamie to confirm provisioning ETA and perf numbers; Lina to attach pricing spreadsheet draft. I’ll consolidate and send RFP response by Friday. @deploybot please attach latest capability matrix template to the thread.

deploybot: attachment uploaded: /assets/capability_matrix_templates/enterprise_matrix_v3.xlsx

maria_solutions: Uploaded initial draft of matrix and RFP answers (internal link): https://internal.redwood/docs/helixx_rfp_draft. Requesting review from eng/security before I send. :eyes:

kevin_security: Reviewing now. One blocker: HelixX requires a data-residency contract clause for EU-only storage. For Private we can guarantee region locks; for Hosted we can offer a contractual commitment if they select EU-only tenancy (needs legal). Flagging as sales blocker until legal signs off.

lina_salesops: Noted — I’ll flag the legal approval path and add conditional pricing if they select EU-only tenancy (approx +12% infra premium).

alex_sales: Good catch. Maria — include the blocker in the RFP response as "Region lock available for Dedicated/Private; hosted requires legal addendum." Keep the rest ready. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
